movesets.name: Defog
movesets.description:
Despite its poor base stats, Cramorant shines as an entry hazard remover thanks to a unique ability that can provide constant pressure on an opposing team as well as spread status in Gulp Missile, pressuring common entry hazard setters like Mudsdale and Palossand, and a defensive typing that lets it check common foes like Arcanine, Hariyama, and Salazzle. Brave Bird synergizes well with Gulp Missile, taking advantage of its Defense drops and forcing out Pokemon like Florges and Milotic that would otherwise not mind staying in on Cramorant. Hurricane avoids the issue of Brave Bird dealing recoil damage and making contact while also hitting Amoonguss harder, but it is prone to missing due to its low accuracy and doesn't take advantage of Gulp Missile's Defense drops. The given EV spread allows Cramorant to avoid a 2HKO from Choice Band Paldean Tauros-F using Close Combat or Flare Blitz while outspeeding Adamant Golurk, while the rest is put into Special Defense to better check special threats like Tastugiri. Tera Steel is recommended to remove Cramorant's Rock and Electric weaknesses while giving it many relevant resistances to the STAB moves of Pokemon such as Florges and Alolan Ninetales and preventing it from being poisoned by foes like Skuntank and Amoonguss.

Cramorant fits best on balance teams that appreciate its ability to remove entry hazards while being able to shore up its poor defenses with multiple defensive partners and support offensive Pokemon by spreading paralysis via Gulp Missile. Its biggest weakness is to Electric-types like Pawmot and Rotom-H, which struggle to come in but consistently force it out, so Grass- and Ground-types like Amoonguss and Rhydon,respectively, are heavily recommended to be able to deal with them. Other Ground-types such as Palossand and Mudsdale can also switch into Rock-type moves such as Stone Edge from Paldean Tauros-F and opposing Rhydon as well as scout the occasional Wild Charge from Arcanine, taking some pressure off of Cramorant. In return, Cramorant can switch into Water-types like Choice item Bruxish locked into Wave Crash and Floatzel, and both Palossand and Mudsdale can help handle Fighting-types such as Hisuian Decidueye and Emboar. Dark-types like Skuntank and Hisuian Qwilfish can also switch into Bruxish's Psychic Fangs with the added benefit of switching into Toxic for Cramorant.

strategies.overview: Cramorant's access to Defog and amazing defensive typing make it one of NU's premier entry hazard control options. Unlike Altaria, which is quite passive, Cramorant can utilize its ability Gulp Missile to spread chip damage and paralysis onto most opposing Pokemon. Gulp Missile, paired with its STAB combination of Water- and Flying-type attacks, also gives Cramorant favorable matchups against many common hazard setters such as Bronzong, Copperajah, and Swampert. Cramorant is also great against offensive teams because it can take on common Fighting-types such as Heracross and Paldean Tauros-W, and Infernape. Despite Cramorant's potency at removing hazards, it is very weak to Electric-type attacks from common Pokemon such as Bellibolt and Raikou. Cramorant also doesn't have as much bulk as other options like Altaria, which makes it take heavy damage from strong neutral attacks such as Overqwil's Gunk Shot and Flamigo's Brave Bird. Furthermore, Cramorant is completely walled by Vaporeon, which can make it hugely ineffective against common balance structures. Special attackers like Munkidori and Choice Specs Chandelure also break Cramorant very effectively, as it doesn't have the special bulk to take hits from any of these Pokemon.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

While niche, Cramorant can use Endure to capitalize on situations where it has a Gulp Missile ready to paralyze the foe, allowing it to survive an incoming attack and recover with Roost or use Surf again. Tera Steel provides a neutrality to Electric-type attacks and gives Cramorant the capability to take several strong, common attacks better such as Munkidori's STAB attacks, Toxtricity's Boomburst, Sylveon's Hyper Voice, and Flygon's Outrage. Hurricane hits Scrafty running Bulk Up more effectively but is less accurate than Brave Bird and thus unreliable.

Checks and Counters

Electric-types and Electric-type coverage: Cramorant's typing causes fast Electric-types like Kilowattrel and Raikou to be especially threatening. Bellibolt is also dangerous for Cramorant because it doesn't care about being hit by Surf and can threaten to OHKO Cramorant back. Several offensive Pokemon can run Electric-type coverage that threatens Cramorant and forces it to switch out, including Infernape and Breloom.

Special Attackers: Cramorant's mediocre special bulk causes it to be very weak to special attackers like Munkidori, Toxtricity, and Meloetta, as they can break through it easily before it even gets the chance to chip them with Gulp Missile.

Vaporeon. Vaporeon completely shuts down Cramorant's main way to hit back against its foes. This makes Cramorant extremely ineffective against the many balance structures Vaporeon features on.

movesets.name: Defogger
movesets.description:
Set Details

Brave Bird ensures that Cramorant can hit Vaporeon, Breloom, and Tsareena, and it synergizes greatly with Gulp Missile's activation dropping the foe's Defense. On the other hand, Ice Beam further improves Cramorant's matchup against Flying-types like Altaria and Kilowattrel, which otherwise don't mind attacking it. The Special Defense EVs allow Cramorant to avoid the 2HKO from Chandelure's Shadow Ball. Tera Ground lets Cramorant block an incoming Volt Switch or Thunderbolt from Raikou or Kilowattrel and hit back with a Surf to set up Gulp Missile. Tera Electric improves Cramorant's matchup against common Flying-types like Kilowattrel, Scyther, and Tornadus.

Toxicroak and Goodra are amazing teammates for Cramorant because of their ability to sweep bulky teams running Vaporeon, which Cramorant cannot touch. Cramorant is also benefitted by the presence of Flygon and Rhyperior, as they are immune to the Electric-type attacks Cramorant cannot handle. Cramorant easily wears down entry hazard-setting Steel-types with Surf as they come in to use Defog, making it a helpful partner for Munkidori, Meloetta, and Tornadus, as they struggle against these foes without support. Cramorant is a useful option for balance teams because it also patches up Water-and Fighting-type weaknesses in defensive cores that use Rhyperior and a Steel-type. Access to Defog makes Cramorant a useful hazard control option for many teams, which benefits Choice Scarf users such as Infernape and bulky Pokemon that prefer to run Leftovers like Klefki and Scrafty.
